ASTRA – Astronaut Health Monitor

Developed a web-based astronaut health monitoring system designed to track and manage crew health during space missions. The application provides health check recording, real-time dashboard visualization of vital signs, body system monitoring, health history tracking, and daily health routine management. It also includes preventive health guidance to address challenges associated with microgravity, isolation, and long-duration spaceflight. The system supports local data storage and CSV export for health record management.
